name: Barra Airport
groundLayout: IBAR has no paved runway or taxiway system - it's an unimproved sand beach landing strip (marked "SAND" on the chart). Aircraft land and taxi directly across the open sand to the Terminal/Fuel point near the north end. There are no taxiway letters, gate numbers, or a runway designator here - never invent one; give taxi instructions in plain terms (e.g. "taxi to the terminal/fuel area") instead of a lettered taxiway route.
